findings.title: Updated Nov 6: Chainalysis Security Incident Information
findings.summary_md: Chainalysis disclosed on October 30, 2026 that an external actor using "offensive agentic techniques" accessed non-sensitive customer data including user IDs, full names, email addresses, and organization role labels, with no evidence of compromised credentials or tokens at that time. In a November 4 update the company disclosed that names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all Chainalysis users were exposed in an on-path (man-in-the-middle) attack. The advisory states there is no evidence that investigation data or attribution repositories were accessed or manipulated.

findings.title: October crypto-tracker hack: Access cracked, law enforcement tokens packed
findings.summary_md: The Register reported on November 5, 2026 that Chainalysis confirmed attackers who broke into its systems in October obtained usernames, password hashes, and live tokens. The piece notes the company's blockchain tools are routinely used to assist police investigations and that the exposure was confirmed in an update written late Wednesday evening, November 4.

findings.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes Passwords and Tokens for All Users, Forcing Service Shutdowns
findings.summary_md: Bitcoin News reported on November 5, 2026 that Chainalysis disclosed hackers accessed password hashes and active authentication tokens for all users, expanding on the initial October 30 report. The company shut down KYT transaction monitoring, address screening, Reactor, Data Solutions, and Chain (Beta), and confirmed the exposure in a November 4 update. It also said it has found no evidence that confidential investigation data was accessed.

findings.title: Chainalysis data breach exposes live tokens for all users
findings.summary_md: Cybernews reported on November 6, 2026 that on Wednesday November 4 Chainalysis discovered names, usernames, password hashes, and live tokens for all users were exposed to an unknown threat actor in an on-path attack. The article notes all customer passwords were reset and that customers whose KYT accounts may have been accessed without authorization are being directly notified. KYT lets companies monitor cryptocurrency transactions.
